The index attempts to measure the performance of the aerospace and defense industry of the U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.

DBC.fund_description: The fund invests in futures contracts in an attempt to track its Index. It holds Treasury Securities, money market mutual funds and T-Bill-ETFs only for margin and/or cash management purposes. The index utilizes an Optimum YieldTM methodology, which seeks to minimize the effects of negative roll yield that may be experienced by other commodities indexes.
